scouting.summary: Never stops coming. Walks you to the fence and chains shot after shot for fifteen minutes.
strengths: Relentless pace and a huge gas tank
weaknesses: Shoots behind his jab, so you know when it's coming
scouting.tell: When his jab is blocked he shoots the double leg straight behind it.
scouting.how_to_beat: Stay off the fence, sprawl and punish him on the way in. Make him pay for every shot so the pace costs him.
